preconditions.description: Number of rooms is between 2 and 100,000.
Number of different values of l is between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and 1 <= v <= 10**6 for x, y, v in tunnels)
preconditions.description: Each tunnel connects two rooms within the range and has a positive time value.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= 10**11 for l in ls)
preconditions.description: Each value of l is between 1 and 10^11.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) and 1 <= line <= n for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer representing the maximum number of children that can be accommodated for the corresponding value of l.
